_notes: Entries here advertise per-model multi-image *input* capability for cloud providers. Schema per entry: {multi_image: bool, max_input_images: int | null}. multi_image=true means the model accepts >1 reference image per request; max_input_images is the cap (null = uncapped or unknown). Live extraction from provider metadata is not currently usable for this signal (NanoGPT's supported_parameters.max_images turns out to be the output-n cap, not the input cap — see adapter.extract_multi_image_info docstring), so this file is the authoritative source. Populate per model via the Phase 2.6 step 5B probe sweep.
